newsitem.title: HONG KONG: IDT mulls purchase of Yeebo.
newsitem.headline: IDT mulls purchase of Yeebo.

text.p: IDT International Ltd has put forward a preliminary conditional proposed purchase of Yeebo (International Holdings) Ltd to Yeebo, it said in a statement published on Friday.

"However, IDT is only one of the parties that have submitted proposals to Yeebo and the Yeebo proposal is still at a very preliminary stage of negotiation," the company's chairman Raymond Chan said in the statement.
"No agreements or understanding have been reached at this stage," Chan said. "It is expected that the Yeebo proposal, if successful, will be financed by internal resources."
IDT shares were unchanged at HK$0.85 in mid-morning.
Yeebo had said earlier its directors had been actively negotiating recapitalization plans with various potential investors.
